summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Writes bare-metal embedded C on STM32 ARM Cortex microcontrollers at register level, building MCU peripheral drivers (GPIO, timers, ADC, I2C, UART) that hold a 3.68 KB Flash footprint at deterministic timing. Motor-drive work covers interrupt-driven quadrature decoding, 15 kHz PWM across four motor channels, and closed-loop feedback control, backed by hardware bring-up, Git workflows, and root-cause debugging.

Embedded & Firmware: MCU Peripherals (GPIO, Timers, ADC, I2C, SPI, UART)

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; root-caused sensor jitter to resolution and calibration settings and corrected it in firmware.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots and supported board bring-up; implemented sensor comms over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national competitions, owning PCB fabrication and hardware/software integration.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used GitLab for version control in a collaborative development environment and JupyterHub for shared analysis and technical documentation.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed ARM Cortex-M4 MCU peripherals directly in bare-metal embedded C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); hit 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver written from registers up; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Built closed-loop heading correction on Arduino Due: derived heading from dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR) and fed angular error back into rotation PWM to hold course during translation.

Implemented interrupt-driven quadrature decoding from first principles as a 4-bit A/B transition state machine; drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM across 4x Cytron motor drivers, with a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect.

Root-caused PWM saturation at 45° diagonals to naive vector summation clipping at 2x full scale; derived angle-weighted atan2 mixing to fix it, reaching Stage 3 of DD Robocon 2023 (99/100 Stage 1, ranked 10th nationally).

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control on STM32 with interrupt-driven UART command handling and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing over I2C with OLED distance readout.
